entries.title: Psalms 110:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool."

entries.title: Psalms 110:2
segments: The LORD shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of Your enemies!

entries.title: Psalms 110:3
segments: Your people [shall be] volunteers In the day of Your power; In the beauties of holiness, from the womb of the morning, You have the dew of Your youth.

entries.title: Psalms 110:4
segments: The LORD has sworn And will not relent, "You [are] a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."

entries.title: Psalms 110:5
segments: ¶The Lord [is] at Your right hand; He shall execute kings in the day of His wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 110:6
segments: He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill [the places] with dead bodies, He shall execute the heads of many countries.

entries.title: Psalms 110:7
segments: He shall drink of the brook by the wayside; Therefore He shall lift up the head.
